h1Text: Outdoor Gym Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Mysore

richText.heading: Outdoor gym equipment supplier in Mysore

c: Mysore's mild weather, wide roads and large gardens make it one of the easiest cities in south India to exercise outdoors. Walkers circle the palace, climb Chamundi Hills and fill the city's parks from early morning. FunPlay Systems is an outdoor gym equipment supplier in Mysore for the city corporation's parks, colleges, residential layouts and the many retired residents' associations.

Our Vasai factory is about 880 km away, and we send the machines to Karnataka by road. Our installation team or a dealer in south India fixes them on site. Mysore stays pleasant for most of the year, with moderate rain from both monsoons. That means the gym will be used through the day, not only at dawn. We still suggest shade over the most popular machines and a level paver base for steady footing.

items.q: Which machines suit a group of senior walkers?
items.a: Three-way twisters, tai chi wheels and seated cycles. They let people exercise together at a gentle pace, with no weights or settings to adjust.

items.q: Can outdoor gym equipment go into a heritage area or old park?
items.a: We can fit machines on a paved strip or a corner that avoids old trees and lawns. Any approval from the authority that runs the park is the owner's responsibility.

items.q: How do I get a layout for my park in Mysore?
items.a: Send the size of the space, photos and the age of the users to sales@funplaysystems.com. We reply with a layout drawing with clear space marked, and a quote.
